fusions.name: Trampling Rush
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 7 tiles to the target, then a weapon strike deals 16 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Anything struck moves 35% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Drum
fusions.desc: Stamps in a tight circle, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves you moving 20% faster for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Relief Post
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. A mount escort fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Haul
fusions.desc: Every 8 tiles you cover, you recover 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%. Once every 12 seconds.
